principles: Every gameplay value must be traceable to a physical, technological, organizational, biological, architectural, or condition input.
The vessel Path level governs the complete technology context; only within-band variation is permitted without explicit exception.
Species and organizations generate persistent manufacturer profiles.
Internals-first and EVA-first are tradeoff doctrines rather than quality tiers.
Passive armor is distributed hull thickness, structural reinforcement, citadel protection, and external-system hardening rather than a detachable module class.
Physical protection and active fields retain separate fore, aft, left, right, up, down, citadel, and structural directional maps.
Sensor and fire-control findings must expose information age, uncertainty, source agreement, and deception risk before weapon performance is considered.
Weapon usefulness is an engagement-solution envelope rather than a fixed physical range.
Incomplete, dismantled, damaged, abandoned, salvaged, wrecked, and destroyed are separate state axes.
A vessel at one hundred percent destruction no longer retains a coherent vessel graph.

phases.title: Governing schemas and technology discipline
acceptance: Existing vessel output wraps without data loss
P0-P6 and T-1 are explicit
Subsystem variation remains within policy
Generation remains deterministic outside timestamps

phases.title: Species-specific manufacturer generator
acceptance: Manufacturers from one species are related but distinct
Ships from one manufacturer remain recognizable
Profiles materially affect engineering and layout

phases.title: Engineering ledger expansion
deliverables: Distributed outer-hull, external-system, structural, and citadel hardening
acceptance: Mass and volume close
Passive hardening derives from area and areal density and is distributed without standalone armor modules
Fore, aft, left, right, up, down, citadel, and structural protection are explicit for physical armor and active fields
Weapons include support and cooling
Combat delta-v is separated from strategic delta-v

phases.title: Semantic module graph
acceptance: INTERNAL modules have valid protected parents
EVA modules have valid vacuum hardpoints
No standalone armor modules are generated
Distributed hardening closes across the actual systems it reinforces
Critical dependencies are connected
Invalid graphs are rejected or visibly repaired

phases.title: Crude three-dimensional voxel assembler
deliverables: Monocoque, spine, cluster, ring, and hybrid algorithms
Six directional hull surfaces plus citadel and structural protection overlays
acceptance: All module volumes fit without treating armor as a module
Load paths and clearances validate
Eight vessel-wide passive and active protection records remain present
Same seed reproduces same layout
Species and manufacturer visibly affect arrangement

phases.title: Condition, history, salvage, and destruction
deliverables: One condition state per intact voxel placement
acceptance: Missing, removed, damaged, and salvaged remain distinct
Missing and removed modules are spatially absent while damaged and destroyed material may remain as wreckage
Seventy-five percent destruction leaves coherent wreckage
One hundred percent destruction removes vessel and voxel-field coherence
Statistics recalculate from surviving graphs and voxel occupancy
The intact module and voxel records remain reference authority
Repair mode records deterministic corrections and strict mode rejects invalid histories

phases.title: Sensors, tracks, and combat geometry
deliverables: Exact one-way and closed-loop light-lag calculations
Target maneuver envelope constrained by acceleration and combat delta-v
Signature, identity, source-agreement, and deception confidence
Observer combat acceleration and delta-v authority
Surviving sensor and fire-control channel application
acceptance: Uncertainty grows with observation age and prediction horizon
Target acceleration and available combat delta-v change the possible displacement envelope
Range, signature, target emissions, aperture, baseline, processing, and surviving sensor state affect track quality
Conflicting observations remain representable as competing hypotheses
Fire-control readiness requires surviving channels and coherent VESSEL-05 graph authority
One-way light lag closes exactly against range divided by the speed of light
A destroyed or incoherent observer retains no active track or fire-control solution
Weapon performance, hit probability, projectile behavior, beam divergence, engagement envelopes, and local impacts remain deferred

phases.title: Weapon-family engineering and engagement envelopes
acceptance: Every weapon reports point-defense, practical, harassment, and theoretical reach
Unguided weapons degrade with maneuver uncertainty
Beam effect degrades with divergence and dwell
Missiles update in flight and face active defense
Weapons occupy valid modules and arcs

phases.title: Local damage and combat resolution
deliverables: Directional hull, citadel, structural, external-system, field, and thermal effects
acceptance: Hits affect actual local systems and directional protection rather than fictitious armor modules
Architecture changes damage outcome
Survival depends on connectivity
Destroyed modules leave usable statistics

phases.title: RPG statistics and action economy
acceptance: Players can operate vessels without reading the full dossier
Every stat links to physical sources
Detailed and simplified resolution remain compatible

phases.title: Integrated UI, export, and campaign persistence
acceptance: Cluster route can germinate a persistent vessel
Exports reload without provenance loss
Earlier vessels migrate without destructive data loss

phases.title: Validation and balance matrix
acceptance: All nine FTL families and seven Path levels remain generatable
Every manufacturer and topology produces valid ships
No weapon dominates every range and target state
Condition percentages remain coherent and distinct
